Allelic state distance between clones

Source: R/clones_assign.R
clone_state_distance.Rd

Base pairs of the shared pieces (segment_pieces()) on which two clones' states differ in their major-haplotype fraction by at least min_df (e.g. 1:1 vs 2:1, 1:0 vs 2:1) or in total copy number by at least min_dcn. Depth-only differences of one copy between amplified states (4:0 vs 3:0) do not count: a cell between two such clones is fitted better by their mixture than by either clone, which is not evidence of a doublet.

Usage

clone_state_distance(segments, min_df = 0.15, min_dcn = 2, min_len = 5e+06)

Arguments

segments

segments table

min_df

minimal difference of the state major fractions

min_dcn

minimal total copy-number difference that counts on its own

min_len

pieces shorter than this are ignored

Value

symmetric numeric matrix clones x clones (bp)
